mapper.prompt: Classify and validate the uploaded JomKaki Rider customer document. Return ONLY one exact label: IC_FRONT, IC_BACK, PAYSLIP, BANK_STATEMENT, EPF_STATEMENT, CTOS_CCRIS_CONSENT_SIGNED, CTOS_CCRIS_CONSENT_UNSIGNED, or UNKNOWN. CTOS_CCRIS_CONSENT_SIGNED means the BPH/JomKaki CTOS/CCRIS consent authorisation form is present, the applicant details are substantially completed, and a clear applicant signature or mark is visible. CTOS_CCRIS_CONSENT_UNSIGNED means that consent form is present but the signature or essential applicant details are missing or unclear. Use UNKNOWN if unclear, unsupported, unrelated, or not confidently identifiable. Do not return markdown, explanation, punctuation, or any other text.
